title: Training-Free Pseudo-Fusion for Composed Image Retrieval with Diffusion Models and Multimodal Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.23102v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Composed Image Retrieval (CIR) is an emerging paradigm in content-based image retrieval that enables users to formulate compositional queries by combining a reference image with an auxiliary modality, usually text-based. This approach supports fine-grained search where the target image shares structural elements with the user-provided image while incorporating the modifications specified by the auxiliary text. Conventional CIR methods rely on multimodal fusion to combine visual and textual features into a joint query embedding, which requires training modules that align composed queries with the targets. translated_title: 基于扩散模型和多模态大语言模型的无训练伪融合组合图像检索
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.23102v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：组合图像检索（CIR）是内容基于图像检索中的一种新兴范式，它允许用户通过将参考图像与辅助模态（通常是文本）结合来构建组合查询。这种方法支持细粒度搜索，其中目标图像与用户提供的图像共享结构元素，同时融入辅助文本指定的修改。传统CIR方法依赖于多模态融合，将视觉和文本特征组合成联合查询嵌入，这需要训练模块来对齐组合查询与目标。在这项工作中，我们提出PeFuse（伪融合），一个无训练框架，利用预训练的扩散模型和多模态大语言模型通过生成式转换桥接模态。我们引入了两种新策略：单向和双向转换，将CIR转换为四种单模态检索任务。
tldr: 我们提出PeFuse，一个无训练框架，利用预训练扩散模型和多模态大语言模型的生成式转换，通过单向和双向转换策略将组合图像检索分解为单模态检索任务，无需额外训练即可实现高效检索。
en_tdlr: We propose PeFuse, a training-free framework that leverages generative conversion from pretrained diffusion models and multimodal LLMs, using uni- and bi-directional strategies to decompose composed image retrieval into single-modality tasks without extra training.
